protocol.status: implementation/preflight only; formal scoring awaits parent confirmation
protocol.image_geometry: EXIF transpose -> RGB -> Pillow BICUBIC direct 224 square; no crop
protocol.numeric: FP32 eager, eval, no AMP; ImageNet mean/std; post-final-LN patch L2 eps=1e-8
protocol.photometric: sRGB -> linear L; per-image per-channel spatial mean mu; clip(a*(b*L+(1-b)*mu),0,1) -> sRGB; no uint8; identity exact shortcut
protocol.identity_meaning: theta index 0; preserve original floating array and reuse original feature

near_duplicate.ssim_gray: EXIF transpose -> RGB -> L -> Pillow LANCZOS 256 square
near_duplicate.cluster_members: all original paths including exact aliases; sorted (pixelhash,path)
near_duplicate.cluster_id: SHA256(newline-joined pixelhash + TAB + relative path), no terminal newline
near_duplicate.cross_split: same-label exact duplicates remove all train members; conflict stops; near duplicates reported only

protocol.distance: FP32 exhaustive squared L2 on unit patches; no approximate retrieval
protocol.ties: theta order, then canonical ref (pixelhash,path), then row-major patch index; strict less update

reference_selection.bow: 5x5 grid by floor(5*(patch_index+.5)/16); 12 counts +1e-6 then normalize; KL(h_ref||h_query), lowest20/25 mean
reference_selection.chamfer: lowest204/256 mean of A[:,r,theta]; choose theta per ref, then K distinct refs

robust_color.statistics: per-channel median and IQR in linear RGB, numpy quantile method=linear
robust_color.target: cross-reference medians of per-image median and floored IQR

projection.fit: CPU float64 E(delta), S0=E(delta delta^T), Sc=S0-mu mu^T
projection.delta: unit augmented patch minus unit identity at same position; all64x8x256
projection.top32: single eigh per matrix; nested first8/16/32
projection.pre: Qz on query and entire bank, L2 eps1e-8, new exhaustive NN
projection.post: Q(original-space winning residual), no renormalization; squared and sqrt top13 means

evaluation.baseline_oracle: investment gate only; never deployment selection or significance
evaluation.CI: none; no physical entity IDs; only official image-split acquisition-condition generalization

purpose: Fixed before any near-duplicate result; no image model computations
